integrity: The proof gives an infinite-dimensional parameter result; checks are finite and independent mathematical review has not been performed. No authorship or independent certification is asserted.
limitations: No complete asymmetric-optimizer classification; no arbitrary edge prices, normalized-Laplacian objective or control-energy conclusions. The earliest verified focal public date is the dated electronic publication of Sun et al. (2006); an unlocated earlier public preprint cannot be ruled out.
scientific_scope: For K_{p,m}, integers m>=p>=3, two conductance-price classes, independently selectable nonnegative edges, unnormalized Laplacian algebraic connectivity; exact global optimal value and a positive optimal two-class allocation.
title: A three-phase price law for complete-bipartite spectral-gap design
